hero.description: Real-time collective defence for regulated financial institutions across Francophone Africa. Detects, correlates, and neutralises fraud schemes before losses escalate.

features.title: Intelligence Built for Francophone Africa's Regulated Sectors
features.description: Every capability designed for the operational and regulatory realities of Francophone African financial infrastructure — BCEAO, COBAC, and FATF-GIABA aligned.

01.title: Collective Fraud Immunity
01.description: When Protegey detects a verified fraud pattern, protections propagate across the ecosystem in milliseconds—reducing exposure before attacks can spread.

02.title: Privacy-Preserving Signals
02.description: Exchange fraud intelligence using HMAC-SHA256 hashed identifiers and encrypted entity data—zero plaintext PII ever crosses institutional boundaries.

03.title: Cross-Sector Correlation
03.description: Correlate signals across banks, fintechs, and telcos to surface coordinated schemes—SIM swaps, mule networks, and synthetic identity rings.

04.title: AML / RCaaS Compliance
04.description: FATF-aligned transaction monitoring, automated SAR drafting, sanctions + PEP screening, and configurable rule thresholds per regulatory jurisdiction.

05.title: Graph Intelligence Engine
05.description: Hot-graph entity links in Postgres + Redis reveal multi-hop fraud rings in sub-50ms. Shared entity intelligence without exposing raw customer data.

06.title: Partner KYB Onboarding
06.description: Configurable questionnaire engine, document collection, integrated risk screening, and EDD auto-trigger for high-risk business customers.

cta.title: Access the Intelligence Layer
cta.description: Protegey operates as a gated fraud intelligence engine, currently focused on Francophone African markets. Access is limited to verified financial institutions, fintechs, telcos, and regulatory bodies.
